lyrics:
[verse]
Bruno tugged on Kiki's leg,
Pulling gently, like a peg!
Kiki laughed, oh that's a joke,
Pulling legs means teasing folk!
[chorus]
Pulling your leg, pulling your leg,
Just a joke, a funny gag!
Pulling your leg, pulling your leg,
Laugh it off and wave the flag!
[verse]
It means I'm joking, just for fun,
A little tease for everyone,
If I say the sky is green,
I'm pulling your leg, you know what I mean!
[chorus]
Pulling your leg, pulling your leg,
Just a joke, a funny gag!
Pulling your leg, pulling your leg,
Giggle, wiggle, wag wag wag!
[outro]
So if a story sounds too wild,
They're pulling your leg, so just smile!
